sql.question: On average, how many completed rides has each active rider taken? Include active riders who have no completed rides.

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(ride_counts.completed_count), 0)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS avg_completed_rides_per_active_rider
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT rider_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_count
  FROM rides
  WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY rider_id
) ride_counts ON ride_counts.rider_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.user_type = 'rider'
  AND u.is_active = true;
